method: Fresh Windows QPA MainWindow processes. A foreground benchmark starts only the next benchmark and attempts AllowSetForegroundWindow for that exact PID, retaining failures. Normal child-process activation is also allowed; neither a grant nor process startup substitutes for actual foreground checks. The next process waits for its predecessor to exit before loading documents and starting timed work. Actual Win32 foreground, activation and exposure are still required. No input-queue attachment, fabricated status or system-setting changes. Startup night; six-way matrix, VLOOK/GitHub/Phycat cycles. Qt-posted menu actions, not native-keyboard latency. Complete viewport QWidget paint, not DWM presentation. Drafts retained/drained; untimed visual and full numbering checks. Coordinator only polls tiny state files/process exit during timing; all statistics and resource hashing are deferred until all GUI processes exit. Nearest-rank sample quantiles; all outliers retained.

runs.method: Windows QPA MainWindow and standard bindings; foreground/exposure checks determine validity. input_delivery distinguishes independent Qt-posted operations from foreground-guarded Win32 SendInput. SendInput is injected OS input, not physical keyboard/IME validation. Paint is completed QWidget dispatch, not DWM presentation. Nearest-rank quantiles and raw samples; 8ms heartbeat and 20ms working-set sampler. Isolated settings/files; autosave/update checks disabled; recovery-draft timers retained. Final drafts are requested and acknowledged asynchronously before the drained memory checkpoint.
